body_lead: Guwahati (Assam) [India], May 16 (ANI): Taking a major leap in the digital and AI ecosystem, Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma on Saturday inaugurated India's first AI-powered "phygital" banking branch of Slice Small Finance Bank at GS Road in Guwahati. According to the release, it may be noted that this next-generation banking space blends physical and digital services seamlessly through AI-enabled self-service kiosks, paperless cash deposits and withdrawals, and streamlined digital onboarding.
